_about: Every dimension revision 1 of the DJI Mini 5 Pro mesh asserts, with its value, its tolerance, its owned source and its evidence grade (plan B.0, B.4). Grades: high, medium-high, medium, low. Only high and medium-high may enter a revision; everything marked 'carry-over' asserts nothing new and is revision 0's own value, kept because the change it belongs to is not in this round.

REVIEW_2026_09_18.reviewer_method: mid-line of the arm band: at 19 stations 25-62 mm inboard of the (fixed) rotor centre, walk perpendicular to a candidate axis, take the centre of the contiguous mask run, and choose the heading that minimises the rms offset. REVIEW_2026_09_18.residual_of_the_built_value: at 65.34 deg the same estimator gives rms 2.576 mm, max 3.50 mm over the same 19 stations; at 68.70 deg it gives rms 0.079 mm, max 0.20 mm — 33x better
REVIEW_2026_09_18.why_the_builder_read_low: work/arm_axis.py derives the axis from the OUTER silhouette only, subtracting an assumed arm half width (w/2)/sin(theta) with w taken from drone_cad._ARM_WIDTH = 11.6-16.5 mm. The band measured perpendicular to the true axis is 10.77 mm, so the subtraction over-corrects and biases theta low.
REVIEW_2026_09_18.consequence: the front arms are built 3.4-3.6 deg off; pinned at the rotor centre that displaces the arm mid-line by up to 3.8 mm at 60 mm inboard and ~5 mm where it meets the shell. open_questions: The official pack width 54.89 mm is wider than the shell measured on the top photo over most of the tail half (51.2 mm at x -50, 52.8 at x 0, 53.8 at x 14, 56.5 at x 30), so the pack cannot sit where the aircraft carries it without being clipped. Revision 1 now puts it where the photos put it and logs the clip (6.92 % by volume, 4846 mm^2 of metal face on the shell surface, 71 coincident metal/plastic triangles). Which is it: (a) keep the tail placement and the clip, (b) keep the official size and drop M5P-5 to an ablation, or (c) the top photo's tail width is under-read? An attempt this round to settle (c) from the FCC top view (fix/fcc_top.py) did NOT succeed: a four-point similarity fit on the motor shafts leaves residuals up to 9.3 mm, because that photo is a close perspective shot (the shell sits about 45 mm above the rotor plane) and no similarity can register both planes.
M5P-1: keep the stretch (the default here), or accept the ablation's declared shortfall? The user has not ruled; the stretch is kept and the ablation keeps its own numbers.
The C.3 front_arm_heading threshold value was changed from 65.34 to 68.97 deg (tolerance unchanged at +-3). Logged as a deviation; needs approval.
The FCC front photo shows a twin-peaked brow at the nose. Neither revision models it; should revision 2?
